Title: Sales Agent signs in on both the mobile API and the web
Steps: 1. POST V2 `login` with the role's credentials 2. sign in through the web `/login` form 3. GET `/lists` with that session
Expected result: an API token, and a signed-in web session (HTTP 200 on /lists, not a redirect to /login)

Title: Business Agent: refused by the mobile API, admitted to the web portal (intentional)
Steps: 1. POST V2 `login` as the Business Agent 2. sign in on the web 3. GET `/manager/api/kpis`
Expected result: no API token; the web portal API answers HTTP 200 (the documented, intentional difference)
